"""Parse simple KEY=VALUE config lines."""

def parse_kv(line):
    """Return (key, value) for a 'KEY=VALUE' line. Values may themselves contain '='."""
    idx = line.index("=")
    key = line[:idx].strip()
    value = line[idx:].strip()
    return key, value
